title: Eight-Week Standard
summary: A balanced 56-day plan for learners at band 3.5–4.5 aiming for 4.5–5. Three full mocks in the TOEFL simulator, two four-week repair cycles, every section in contact every week, and a final week built from the Final 14 Days guide.

daily_routine: 15–20 minutes: one Complete the Words paragraph or ten Listen and Repeat sentences
weekly_rhythm: Two heavier days (timed sets or a mock)
One review day (60 minutes, error-log counts and plan)

weeks.label: Week 1 · Baseline and profile
tasks: Full mock 1 in the TOEFL simulator (full exam), real order, no pauses.
Review the mock and write section bands, timing notes and your profile (A–D) from the Band 4 to 5 Roadmap.
Set up the error log with the 14 categories and log every miss from the mock.
Read the Score Scale 2026 module and write your exact target: overall band, section minimums, deadline.
Two short drill sessions on the largest category.
Weekly review: choose priority section and maintenance section for weeks 2–4.

weeks.label: Week 2 · Priority section foundations
tasks: Four sessions of priority-section drills matched to its largest category.
Daily Complete the Words paragraph using the five-step routine; log misses by type (SLOT, FAMILY, AGREE, PHRASE, SMALL, SPELL, VOCAB).
Two Build a Sentence sets in simulator practice; log every miss by sentence structure.
One listening session with reply-type labelling for Listen and Choose a Response.
One speaking session: Listen and Repeat exactness and one interview.
Weekly review: measure drill accuracy for the priority category.

checkpoint.target: Accuracy trend recorded (no change after two weeks means change the drill)

weeks.label: Week 3 · Timed sets and productive feedback
tasks: Three timed sets of the priority section.
Two timed emails (7 minutes) and one discussion post (10 minutes) with the two-minute proofread.
Two interviews using the Recall, Reaction, Position and Proposal frameworks, recorded and self-scored.
Thought-group and stress routine on one model answer.
Maintenance: one reading or listening set.
Weekly review.

checkpoint.measure: Two timed writing tasks reviewed line by line
checkpoint.target: Every email bullet covered; proofread catches most errors

weeks.label: Week 4 · Section mock and first re-check
tasks: Section mock of the priority section in simulator practice.
Full review with the 90-minute protocol; recount categories.
Two drill sessions on whatever is still largest.
One academic discussion post and one interview.
Choose the second priority section for weeks 5–7.
Weekly review.

checkpoint.target: At least half a band above baseline in the priority section, or a clear drop in its error count

weeks.label: Week 5 · Second priority
tasks: Four sessions on the second priority section.
Two short maintenance sessions for the first priority section.
Three academic talks with purpose-and-structure notes.
Ten Listen and Repeat sentences on three days.
One email to a new reader type (office or manager).
Weekly review.

checkpoint.target: Total misses per set falling in both priority sections

weeks.label: Week 6 · Full mock 2 and re-profile
tasks: Full mock 2 in the TOEFL simulator under the same conditions as mock 1.
Review and compare with mock 1 section by section.
Re-check your profile; if it changed, change the priority for week 7.
Two drill sessions on the two largest categories.
One timed writing pair (email and discussion).
Weekly review.

checkpoint.target: Overall at least half a band above mock 1, or within half a band of target

weeks.label: Week 7 · Close the two biggest gaps
tasks: Start the Final 14 Days guide: run its Day 14 to Day 8 tasks this week.
Four drill sessions on the two largest categories from mock 2.
Redo ten old log entries without answers; count how many you now get right.
Reschedule decision by the end of the week if needed (ETS: at least four full days before the test).
Confirm score recipients.
Weekly review.

simulator.action: Full mock 3 at the end of the week

checkpoint.measure: Repeat-error rate on old log entries
checkpoint.target: Most old entries now answered correctly

weeks.label: Week 8 · Final week and test
tasks: Review full mock 3 and write the top-ten error list.
Run the Final 14 Days guide's Day 6 to Day 1 tasks.
Home Edition: equipment check and room rehearsal; test center: route and 30-minute early arrival.
Light practice only in the last three days; no full mocks.
Test day: follow the routine and the report-or-cancel rule you wrote in advance.

checkpoint.target: Decision: test as planned, or extend with the Twelve-Week Foundation or a priority plan

checkpoints.target_band: Overall +0.5 over mock 1 or within 0.5 of target
At target or within a quarter band

decision_rules: No movement in a priority section after two full mocks four weeks apart: re-label the last 30 log entries before changing anything else.
If one section drops while you push another, add two maintenance sessions a week for it.
If mock 2 shows Writing or Speaking at least half a band below Reading and Listening, switch weeks 7–8 to the Speaking and Writing Priority plan's final weeks.

metadata.recommended_for: A test date about two months away and a gap of up to one band.
metadata.score_window_basis: score_min/score_max are the ETS 0-120 comparison totals for band 3.5 (58+) and the top of band 5 (106); band windows are in band_*
metadata.guarantee: none: practice plan, not a score prediction
